title: Atlas v0.2: Editorial redesign, zero-debt posters, and System-1 decision models (Laya & OpenJev)
body: Redesigned the entire web experience with light/dark theme switching, interactive paradigm filtering, embedded per-card Architecture Genomes, mobile reading cards, layer drill-down inspection, and unified editorial poster layouts across all models with zero geometry debt. Added the System-1 (non-autoregressive Jev-class) decision paradigm with convaiinnovations/laya (ModernBERT + [MASK] MLP head + RLCD) and openjev/openjev (hybrid Qwen3.5 + shared prefix KV + Pos-0 letter logit readout).

title: Atlas v0.1: six models, generated figures, compare and evidence
body: First public catalog: Llama 3 8B, Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek V3, Qwen3-Next 80B-A3B, Kimi Linear 48B-A3B and GLM-5.3-Flash. Every figure is generated from an Architecture IR and every number traces to an evidence claim. Includes two-model comparison with layer-genome alignment, SVG/PNG export and dark-theme support.
